title: BR-Whitefield branch router BGP session drop
root_cause: BGP session dropped after firmware event on branch router. iBGP peer 10.255.0.2 (ZO-Bengaluru) lost Established state for 4 minutes.
resolution: Manual BGP clear on branch (vtysh clear ip bgp *). Session re-established with ZO. Traffic rerouted during the 4-minute window via SD-WAN backup.
